dialogues.speaker: Archaic Lord of Lightning and Blitz
dialogues.text: Farewell! You are most welcome to visit me again.

dialogues.speaker: Archaic Lord of Lightning and Blitz
dialogues.text: There is a saying that goes: "Even a champion is defenseless against a frenzy of fists; even a master may be slain by a stray roof tile..." Remember it well, my child!
